description:
[Game reference] Every animal, NPC and boss: HP, hardest hit, aggro range, top speed. One row per creature (`key`, `name`, `group`, `hp`, `max_hit`, `aggro_range` in metres, `top_speed` m/s,
`players_reaction` attacks/flees for animals, `url`). Fetch one with `/bestiary/{key}`. Animal/NPC/boss keys for get_creature. Link https://rust.wiki/bestiary.
name: list_creatures
title: Every animal, NPC and boss: HP, hardest hit, aggro range, top speed
